messages:
ava: Heads-up: We're seeing intermittent deserialization errors in SDK v2.9 when handling model-bind metadata for quantized weights. errors ~0.4% but concentrated in ap-southeast-1. opening a thread to propose a regional SDK unpin for that region.

rik: I can validate whether runtime is implicated. ran quick cross-check vs runtime 3.2.1 and 3.1.9; runtime looks clean. leaning SDK-only.

ops-bot: nightly-check: ap-southeast-1 q-llama3q longseq p95 210ms, token_error_rate 0.1% (baseline tok_err 0.08%).

ava: Proposed plan: at 04:30 UTC pin sdk->2.8 in ap-southeast-1, cohort rollout 25% -> 75% -> 100% with 10m observation gates. Auto-rollback to global 2.8 if signature_error_rate > 1% or token_error_rate > 1% for 5m. keep runtime pinned.

sre-oncall: I'll wire alerts and standby for 04:20. set alert threshold: deserialization_failures > 0.6% over 2m. follow runbook: /runbooks/regional-unpin.md on trigger.

rik: I'll add extra header-compat logging to the 2.9 branch and push a debug build for telemetry. PR #4332.

deploybot: Automessage: requested pin update sdk:2.8 region:ap-southeast-1. Requires approvals: eng, infra.

ava: Approvals: eng:ava, infra:rik. Scheduling at 04:30 UTC. remember to flush prefix cache for quant models before cohort flip: `ops cache flush --region ap-southeast-1 --models q-*`

deploybot: Action: pinned sdk:2.8 in ap-southeast-1 cohort=25%. Health-gate: token_error_rate < 1% && p95 < baseline+80ms for 10m. Auto-rollback: configured to global 2.8 if gate fails.

rik: first cohort stable after 10m. token_error_rate 0.09%, p95 +12ms. increasing cohort to 75%.

ops-bot: telemetry snapshot attached to deploy ticket.

sre-oncall: no abnormal alerts. maintaining watch for next 20m.

ava: decision: promote to 100% in region. action items: merge PR #4332 with additional logs and schedule global rollout once validated. filing compliance audit ticket A-7930.

deploybot: Reminder: attach run artifacts and update release notes: note regional SDK rollback for ap-southeast-1 due to deserialization edge-case.

ava: thanks all. closing thread once PR merges and we confirm no regression on promoted telemetry.
